**Record** in the `Latiprimere` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Abstractions](/docs/reference/#latiprimereabstractions) package.

```csharp
public sealed record MediaSize
```

A paper size a printer can print on.

Sizes are identified by their PWG 5101.1 self-describing name, such as `iso_a4_210x297mm` or `na_letter_8.5x11in`, on every print system, so the same paper has the same name whichever print system reports it. Sizes without a standard name are named `custom_`, followed by their dimensions. Compare sizes by [MediaSize.Name](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/mediasize/#name): record equality also compares [MediaSize.DisplayName](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/mediasize/#displayname), which differs between printer drivers.


## Properties

### DisplayName

```csharp
public required string DisplayName { get; init; }
```

Gets a name to show people, such as "A4" or "Letter". Comes from the printer driver where it has one.

### HeightMillimetres

```csharp
public required double HeightMillimetres { get; init; }
```

Gets the height in millimetres, with the paper in portrait.

### Name

```csharp
public required string Name { get; init; }
```

Gets the PWG self-describing name, such as `iso_a4_210x297mm`.

### WidthMillimetres

```csharp
public required double WidthMillimetres { get; init; }
```

Gets the width in millimetres, with the paper in portrait.
